obituaries.full_text:
Ralph Norwood  
Dec. 16, 
1965

NORWOOD- In Lewes, Del. on Dec. 16, 
1965
, Ralph Norwood, brother of Clarence & Thomas Norwood of Lewes.  Aged 78 years. Relatives and friends are invited to attend the funeral from the Israel Methodist Church, Lewes, Del. on Mon. afternoon Dec. 20th at 1 o'clock. Interment in the adjoining Cemetary. Friends may call at his late residence in Sunday evening from 7 to 9. Arrangements by the Stevenson Funeral Home.
